title: Wave1 narrow supported config execution result

official_litespeed.lazy_image_excludes: Supported for excluding exact filenames/URLs from LiteSpeed lazy loading.
official_litespeed.vpi: Official supported mechanism for detecting above-the-fold images, excluding them from lazy load, and preloading them.
official_litespeed.vpi_dependency: Requires QUIC.cloud Page Optimization/VPI service; fee may apply.

conclusion: Narrow Lazy Load Image Excludes did not satisfy the acceptance criteria because native/theme lazy-loading remains and calculator primary src did not match the tested variant. The exact setting was rolled back. No permanent admin-setting expansion remains.

next_supported_unlock.reason: For LCP, LiteSpeed VPI is the documented supported above-the-fold preload path but requires QUIC.cloud service and may incur cost, so it was not enabled without explicit consent. For accessibility, no supported IranKala setting/ability was found; vendor-supported renderer change remains required.
